transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
Take my what? Speak up, dear
I understand it might be a bit hard to hear me. I'm asking if you've had a chance to take your medication today. Would you like to check your medication box to see if today's dose has been taken?
Oh, my pills — yes, I took them from the box this morning
That's great to hear that you've taken your pills this morning! Just to make sure I understood correctly, did you take today's dose from your medication box?
Thank you for confirming that. It's wonderful to know you've taken your medication today. If you need anything else, feel free to let your caregiver know. Have a lovely day!
